insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured: 50 Lacs, 75 Lacs, 1 Crore, 2 Crores, 3 Crores, 4 Crores, 5 Crores, 6 Crores (as per Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room Rent Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | Hospitalization Treatment
great.explanation: Room rent is payable at actuals up to the Sum Insured, with no per-day cap mentioned. This reduces the risk of room-rent linked deductions and gives flexibility to choose the room you need.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Super Reload (Unlimited Refill) From 2nd claim of Policy Life - Unlimited times
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | In-built Benefits
great.explanation: Unlimited refill of the Sum Insured is available from the 2nd claim onwards during the policy life. This helps if you have multiple hospitalizations and the base cover gets used up.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | Hospitalization Treatment
great.explanation: Non-payable consumables/non-medical items are covered as per all 4 lists in Annexure I. This can significantly reduce out-of-pocket costs that are commonly rejected in many policies.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 90 days before the hospitalization date. This helps pay for consultations, tests, and medicines leading up to admission.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: If the Base Sum Insured is completely exhausted or is insufficient for covering a claim, then We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: When the Base Sum Insured is exhausted or insufficient, an additional amount equal to the Base Sum Insured is reloaded unlimited times in the policy year. This provides strong protection against large or repeated claims in the same year.

great.name: Co-pay
great.quote: Co-Payment: means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the Policyholder / Insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
great.explanation: Only a standard definition of co-payment is provided and no applied co-pay clause is shown in the quoted text. No co-pay is charged on this plan based on the provided extract, meaning the insurer pays 100% of admissible claims.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Pre Existing Disease (PED) Waiting Period 3 years
good.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | Waiting Period - Inbuilt Cover
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after a waiting period of 3 years. This is within the common 2–4 year range in retail health insurance.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: 30-day Waiting Period (Code-Excl03) ... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Treatment for illnesses is not covered in the first 30 days from the first policy start date, except for accidents. This is a standard waiting period in most health insurance plans.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 180 days after discharge. This supports follow-up treatment and medicines for a relatively long period.

bad.name: NCB
bad.quote: Super Reload (Unlimited Refill) ... | HealthReturnsTM ... Applicable up to 100% of the premium
bad.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | In-built Benefits
bad.explanation: The extract refers to HealthReturnsTM (up to 100% of premium) but does not show any No Claim Bonus that increases Sum Insured. If there is no NCB on Sum Insured, your cover may not grow automatically for claim-free years.
